defect_summary: Damaged blister packaging and broken seals
complaint_text:
Customer Complaint Report
Complaint Source: Customer
Customer Name: ABC Healthcare Pharmacy
Product Name: Paracetamol 500 mg Tablets
Batch / Lot Number: PAR500-B2026-041
Manufacturing Site: Mumbai Manufacturing Site
Affected Quantity: 25 packs
Complaint Category: Packaging Defect
Complaint Description: The customer reported that several packs of Paracetamol 500 mg tablets were
received with damaged blister packaging and broken seals. The issue was identified during incoming
inspection. No adverse health effects were reported. The customer requested an investigation and
replacement of the affected units.
